title: [model] add GLM-4.1V
bodyExcerpt:
# What does this PR do?
Add a new reasoning VLM _GLM4.1v_


## _**installation**_
Please use the latest transformers to have a try!  Do not forget `DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1`.
```
pip install -U transformers
```
## _**data preparation**_
For data preparation please refer to [here](https://github.com/THUDM/GLM-4.1V-Thinking?tab=readme-ov-file#model-fine-tuning)

## Before submitting

- [x] Did you read the [contributor guideline](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)?
- [ ] Did you write any new necessary tests?
